sections.kicker: Prepared for FRVD by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new runner would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: FRVD has a manifesto in its name. The club page hides it behind a schedule.
sections.keep: Your line, "Forever Ready Versus Delayed." Few run clubs have a name that means something.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.

pins.what: The meaning of FRVD sits in quotes and then disappears.
pins.why: It is the reason a runner joins you instead of another Tuesday club.
pins.how: Make the line the voice of everything you post and launch.
pins.label: Your name
pins.cost: Your launch arrives as a new product, not as FRVD.

pins.what: The account calls itself a run club first.
pins.why: Any new launch needs FRVD to stand for more than a meeting time.
pins.how: Decide what FRVD is beyond Tuesdays before you launch.
pins.label: Your title
pins.cost: The launch inherits the label of a local club.

pins.what: New members go to a plain form.
pins.why: The first owned touch with a runner looks like a survey.
pins.how: Give joining FRVD its own branded page.
pins.label: Your link
pins.cost: The welcome feels like admin instead of a team.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at FRVD, and you said you are launching something new. I spent time on your Instagram. Three things stood out, and they matter before a launch.

title: We fix this kind of

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on FRVD's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Nike, from sport. It turned one short line into a reason to show up.
